sam: quick check — trying to repro a customer bug in staging that requires capturing full request + response bodies for ~10 sessions. payloads include emails, phone numbers, and occasionally an auth token in headers. can i enable TEMP_FULL_BODY_LOGGING for 2h scoped to one pod (staging/bugfix-123)? plan: strip Authorization header, hash user_id with sha256+pepper from KMS, redact local-part of emails, and redact any token-like strings. any objections or must-have constraints?

laura: who will need access to the collected files? we should limit to a tiny allowlist (me + sam + support lead) and make it time-limited. also need retention window (delete after 24h).

security: quick guidance — do NOT log raw tokens or full auth headers. For headers: replace Authorization with '<REDACTED_TOKEN>' or remove entirely. For identifiers: prefer per-tenant HMAC (KMS-backed) vs plain hash, so we can detect duplicates without revealing info. Emails: either redact local-part (foo@domain.com -> <REDACTED>@domain.com) or store HMAC(email). Phone numbers: redact fully. You must open a ticket with justification, timeframe, and access list. Security review + audit trail required.

ben: infra-bot says feature flag exists. TEMP_FULL_BODY_LOG can be toggled via deploy pipeline and accepts LOG_SCRUB_RULES env. please set the pod label staging/bugfix-123 and include S3 path with restricted ACL.

sam: will open ENG-4592 now with timeframe (2h window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 UTC), participants (sam, laura, support-lead), and exact scrub rules. proposed scrub config snippet below:

```
LOG_SCRUB_RULES:
  - headers:
      Authorization: REDACT
  - body:
      email: redact_localpart
      phone: redact_all
      prompt: hmac_with_kms_key
      user_id: hmac_with_kms_key
```

security: approve in principle once ticket is created with those fields. requirement checklist: ticket + time window + allowlist + S3 ACL + KMS key reference + post-run proof-of-delete. we will grant temporary S3 view perms after ticket review. @laura please ack you'll be one of the approvers and will remove access after verification.

laura: ack, will review the ticket and verify deletes. sam — include a sample scrubbed log line in the ticket so we can validate before granting access.
